triggers.definition: CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER attendance_correction_required AFTER UPDATE ON public.attendances DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION require_attendance_correction()
CREATE TRIGGER attendance_episode_guard BEFORE INSERT ON public.attendances FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_attendance_episode()
CREATE TRIGGER attendance_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.attendances FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_attendance()
CREATE TRIGGER audit_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.audit_events FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION forbid_history_mutation()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER audit_requires_correction AFTER INSERT ON public.audit_events DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION require_audit_correction()
CREATE TRIGGER correction_append_only BEFORE DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.attendance_corrections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION forbid_history_mutation()
CREATE CONSTRAINT TRIGGER correction_requires_transition AFTER INSERT ON public.attendance_corrections DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION require_correction_transition()
CREATE TRIGGER correction_transaction BEFORE INSERT ON public.attendance_corrections FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION stamp_correction_transaction()
CREATE TRIGGER enrollment_period_guard BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE ON public.enrollments FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION guard_enrollment_period()
